notes: Written 2026-11-03 from the build's own definitions only (runs/full/zflx/r3/exec: ui_flow_83e21daf...json.md and map_helper.txt, workflow_45143f53... (ui_carddemo), systems.txt, data_types.txt; builder/assumptions.md; the END-node payloads from transcript tool-call inputs), before any workflow of the build was run and before any output was opened. No FlowX call was made.

UI flow: one UI flow (CardDemo), one page (CardDemoPage) whose cards are shown by the state key `screen`: SIGNON, MENU, ADMIN, ACCTVIEW, ACCTUPD, CARDLIST, CARDVIEW, CARDUPD, TRANLIST, TRANVIEW, TRANADD, REPORT, BILLPAY, USERLIST, USERADD, USERUPD, USERDEL, BYE. Each legacy map is one card; BYE is the TEXT screen. Navigation is the `screen` value in the response (nav rules on every workflow action) or the target of a UI event (workflow null).

Every workflow button sends START_WORKFLOW ui_carddemo (<uuid>) with startParams {type, sess, f}; `f` is the card's own state object (so, mn, am, av, au, cl, cv, cu, tl, tv, ta, rp, bp, ul, ua, uu, ud). The END node returns ${view}: the state keys to overwrite (err, msg, screen when it changes, sess when it changes, and the card states). Response paths are read from the dispatcher's last pass only (the pass with no DB operations), as that is the only pass whose `view` is output.

Body: `type` is the button's action type; sess.uid/utype/fname/lname/acct/card come from the adapter session; f.<key> comes from the form for keys bound to inputs, and from the session for state the card keeps but does not show as an input (list paging keys first/last/page and row objects r0..rN, au.step/au.o/au.rv/au.e.cid, cu.step/cu.o/cu.from, cv.from, tv.from, uu.loaded/uu.from, ud.fname/lname/utype/loaded/from). Back buttons on CARDVIEW/CARDUPD/TRANVIEW/USERUPD/USERDEL send f.to (the card's `from`) and the list state (f.cl/f.tl/f.ul) from the session.

Session keys are written only from responses of actions whose last pass returns that state key; on a path that does not return it the adapter writes empty, while the page keeps its earlier value (for sess.acct/sess.card after a failed account view, card view or card-list Enter: the next menu prefill of ACCTSID/CARDSID is empty in the adapter, the earlier value on the page).

Messages: the page shows err and msg in the header. Screens whose legacy map has INFOMSG (CACTVWA, CACTUPA, CCRDLIA, CCRDSLA, CCRDUPA): ERRMSG = err, INFOMSG = msg. Other screens: ERRMSG = err|msg (fix 6: exactly one of the two is non-empty on every path of these actions; both filled gives the ambiguity marker).

Instrument fix 7 (compose): CACTUPA's date boxes au.e.open/exp/reiss/dob, label '... (YYYY-MM-DD)', templates {OPNYEAR}-{OPNMON}-{OPNDAY}, {EXPYEAR}-{EXPMON}-{EXPDAY}, {RISYEAR}-{RISMON}-{RISDAY}, {DOBYEAR}-{DOBMON}-{DOBDAY}; CORPT0A's rp.sd/rp.ed, placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD', templates {SDTYYYY}-{SDTMM}-{SDTDD}, {EDTYYYY}-{EDTMM}-{EDTDD}.

Instrument fix 7 (split): CACTVWA texts avd.* are 'Label: value' strings built by the dispatcher's acctDisplay (labels 'Active Y/N: ', 'Opened: ', 'Expiry: ', 'Reissue: ', 'Credit Limit: ', 'Cash credit Limit: ', 'Current Balance: ', 'Current Cycle Credit: ', 'Current Cycle Debit: ', 'Account Group: ', 'Customer id: ', 'SSN: ', 'Date of birth: ', 'FICO Score: ', 'First Name: ', 'Middle Name: ', 'Last Name: ', 'Address: ', 'Address line 2: ', 'City: ', 'State: ', 'Zip: ', 'Country: ', 'Phone 1: ', 'Phone 2: ', 'Government Issued Id Ref: ', 'EFT Account Id: ', 'Primary Card Holder Y/N: '); CCRDSLA texts cvd.name 'Name on card: {CRDNAME}', cvd.active 'Card Active Y/N: {CRDSTCD}', cvd.exp 'Expiry Date: {EXPMON}/{EXPYEAR}'; COTRN1A texts tvd.* ('Transaction ID: ', 'Card Number: ', 'Type CD: ', 'Category CD: ', 'Source: ', 'Description: ', 'Amount: ', 'Orig Date: ', 'Proc Date: ', 'Merchant ID: ', 'Merchant Name: ', 'Merchant City: ', 'Merchant Zip: '). avd.acct ('Account Number: ...') repeats the ACCTSID input and is not split.

ENTER on CACTUPA and CCRDUPA (coordinator ruling, fix 9 conditional AID): while au.step / cu.step is SEARCH (or empty) ENTER is 'Fetch account' / 'Fetch card' (auget / cuget), because the build hides 'Enter=Validate' in that step and Fetch is the only button a person's ENTER can mean; in EDIT or CONFIRM it is 'Enter=Validate' (auval / cuval), as the label states (assumption A5). Same correspondence for the other mode-dependent keys, from the hide rules: PF5 'F5=Save' only in CONFIRM, PF12 'F12=Cancel' only in EDIT or CONFIRM (CACTUPA, CCRDUPA); COUSR2A PF5 'F5=Save' only when uu.loaded is 'Y'; COUSR3A PF5 'F5=Delete' only when ud.loaded is 'Y'. In any other step the key is not reachable (no visible button). The step is the session key au_step / cu_step / uu_loaded / ud_loaded, written from every response that returns that state (menu, admin, list Enter, and the card's own actions).

Not reachable (no button carries the key): CACTVWA PF5, CCRDUPA PF9, COTRN1A PF5 and PF9, COTRN2A PF9, CORPT0A PF5, COBIL0A PF5, COUSR1A PF9, COUSR2A PF12, COUSR3A PF12, COSGN0A PF5, COMEN1A PF5, COADM1A PF5. Legacy fields with no page element: COMEN1A OPTN012, COADM1A OPTN007-OPTN012, CCRDUPA EXPDAY, CCRDLIA CRDSTP2-7. CORPT0A MONTHLY/YEARLY/CUSTOM are mapped since fix 8 by 'choose' onto the SELECT rp.type (Report type; options 'Monthly (Current Month)' MONTHLY, 'Yearly (Current Year)' YEARLY, 'Custom (Date Range)' CUSTOM): a non-blank legacy mark puts that code in rp.type.

PF3 on COSGN0A, COMEN1A and COADM1A is a UI event of the page that sets screen BYE (TEXT); PF3 on CACTVWA, CACTUPA, CCRDLIA, COTRN0A, COTRN2A, CORPT0A, COBIL0A is a UI event to MENU; on COUSR0A and COUSR1A to ADMIN. PF4 on COTRN1A is a UI event that clears the detail texts and keeps the typed Tran ID (no clear_form); PF4 on COTRN2A, COBIL0A, COUSR1A, COUSR2A, COUSR3A clears the card's state (clear_form). The PF4 events on COUSR2A/COUSR3A also reset uu.from/ud.from to ADMIN on the page; a workflow-null action cannot write the adapter session, so the adapter keeps the earlier from.

Instrument limits that this map cannot avoid (for the coordinator): (a) resolved by fix 8 carry: every navigating action now maps the target cards' input boxes through 'form' (menu, admin, signon, list Enter, Back to a list), so a prefilled or selected value is displayed and sent by the next action; (b) hide rules are modelled for the mode-dependent keys through fix 9 conditional AIDs (note 8); (c) 'split' runs after 'show' and is not target-aware: on card-list Enter the CCRDSLA texts are split from cvd.*, so a U selection that lands on CCRDUPA shows CRDNAME/CRDSTCD/EXPMON/EXPYEAR blank at arrival; (d) resolved with (a): input boxes are no longer shown through 'cv.acct|cu.acct|cl.acct'-style alternations, each screen reads its own box, so no ambiguity marker; (e) the page shows 'Page N' only when N > 0: the adapter shows PAGENO/PAGENUM as the number, also 0.

Browser: each screen carries its card title (fix 9 'title', anchored to the ui_flow card title: 'Signon to CardDemo', 'Main Menu', 'Admin Menu', 'View Account', 'Update Account', 'List Credit Cards', 'View Credit Card Detail', 'Update Credit Card Details', 'List Transactions', 'View Transaction', 'Add Transaction', 'Transaction Reports', 'Bill Payment', 'List Users', 'Add User', 'Update User', 'Delete User'); detect is kept where the button is always visible (COSGN0A 'Sign on (Enter)', CACTUPA 'Fetch account', CCRDUPA 'Fetch card', COTRN2A 'F5=Copy Last Tran.'), dropped on COUSR3A ('F5=Delete' is visible only after a fetch). TEXT is the BYE card by text. CORPT0A report type: combo 'Report type' with options ^monthly/^yearly/^custom. Limit: on CACTUPA/CCRDUPA the browser ENTER stays '^enter=validate$': 'Fetch account'/'Fetch card' are never hidden and come before 'Enter=Validate' in the DOM, so an alternation would click Fetch in every step; a search-step ENTER in the browser therefore finds no visible button (not reached), while the adapter replay maps it to Fetch. Input indexes count visible inputs with every hidden form shown (CACTUPA in EDIT, CCRDUPA in EDIT, COUSR2A loaded); CORPT0A assumes the SELECT is not an <input> (unverified).

Stores: one NOSQL system per contract store; field names and types follow CONTRACT-UI-FULL exactly (data_types.txt: ints INTEGER, amounts FLOAT, dates and timestamps strings), so fields are identity and no as_text. JOBS = job_requests {start_date, end_date}. No loader in this map (assumption D4: the build has no load/unload jobs).
